title: Use Seedance 2.0’s audio reference feature by uploading an audio clip (your own…
content:
Use Seedance 2.0’s audio reference feature by uploading an audio clip (your own voice or a generated voice from ElevenLabs/Bland AI) to get more realistic, less robotic VO in AI UGC videos.  
If Seedance 2.0 lip sync is slightly off when using an audio reference, fix the mouth movements in Higgsfield Lip Sync Studio.
